mapper.sql: r.id, r.batch_id, b.order_no, b.submitted_by_customer_id AS buyer_customer_id, buyer.nickname AS buyer_nickname, b.contact_name, b.contact_phone, b.participant_count, b.quoted_amount, b.payable_amount, COALESCE(b.final_amount,r.final_amount) AS final_amount, COALESCE(b.settlement_status,r.settlement_status) AS settlement_status, COALESCE(b.settlement_type,r.settlement_type) AS settlement_type, COALESCE(b.pass_units,r.pass_units) AS pass_units, COALESCE(b.pass_account_id,r.pass_account_id) AS pass_account_id, COALESCE(b.settlement_note,r.settlement_note) AS settlement_note, b.payment_status AS batch_payment_status, r.customer_id, c.customer_no, c.nickname, c.real_name, r.session_id, s.session_number, s.name AS session_name, COALESCE(r.unit_price,s.standard_price) AS standard_price, r.registration_status, r.payment_status, r.registration_source, r.registered_at, r.session_referrer_customer_id, ref.nickname AS referrer_nickname, r.return_primary_trigger, r.return_trigger_note, r.attribution_source, r.remark, r.revision
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ql_registration r INNER JOIN ql_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id INNER JOIN ql_session s ON s.id = r.session_id LEFT JOIN ql_registration_batch b ON b.id = r.batch_id LEFT JOIN ql_customer buyer ON buyer.id = b.submitted_by_customer_id LEFT JOIN ql_customer ref ON ref.id = r.session_referrer_customer_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.session_id AS sessionId, b.submitted_by_customer_id AS buyerCustomerId, b.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.quoted_amount AS quotedAmount, b.payable_amount AS payableAmount, b.final_amount AS finalAmount, b.settlement_status AS settlementStatus, b.settlement_type AS settlementType, b.pass_account_id AS passAccountId FROM ql_registration_batch b WHERE b.id = #{batchId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM ql_registration WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ql_registration_batch SET final_amount=#{finalAmount}, payable_amount=#{finalAmount}, settlement_status='confirmed', settlement_type=#{settlementType}, pass_units=#{passUnits}, pass_account_id=#{passAccountId}, settlement_note=#{note}, settlement_confirmed_by=#{operatorId}, settlement_confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt} WHERE id=#{batchId} AND payment_status='unpaid' AND settlement_status='pending'

UPDATE ql_registration SET final_amount=#{finalAmount}, settlement_status='confirmed', settlement_type=#{settlementType}, pass_units=#{passUnits}, pass_account_id=#{passAccountId}, settlement_note=#{note}, settlement_confirmed_by=#{operatorId}, settlement_confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt}, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_at=#{confirmedAt}, revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status='unpaid' AND settlement_status='pending'
